description: WordPress Block Patterns for Sjokoladerommet. Access via: Add Block → Patterns → Sjokoladerommet.

patterns.title: Hero – Enkel seksjon
patterns.description: Simple hero section with eyebrow label, H1 title, lead text, and info chips. Use on Meny, Om oss, Bestill kake pages.

editable_as_blocks.description: Short uppercase label above the title

html_only.description: Info chips (opening hours, address) — edit via HTML view

patterns.title: Hero – Fullskjerm med bilde (Forside)
patterns.description: Homepage hero with diagonal-stripe background, 2-column grid, and portrait photo on the right.

editable_as_blocks.description: Portrait photo — use 4:5 ratio image for best result

html_only.description: Primary and outline buttons with hrefs

patterns.title: Tre kort – Signaturprodukter
patterns.description: 3-column product card grid with image, title, and description. Shows signature products.

html_only.description: Eyebrow + H2 + 'Hele menyen' link — edit via HTML view

patterns.title: Tekst og bilde – Med sitat
patterns.description: 2-column section: portrait photo left, eyebrow + H2 + lead + styled blockquote + button right.

html_only.description: Styled quote block and CTA button

patterns.title: Tjenester og bilde – Velværeavdelingen
patterns.description: 2-column section: services list with prices and booking button left, image right.

html_only.description: 4 service cards with names and prices

patterns.title: CTA – Mørk bakgrunn
patterns.description: Dark brown call-to-action section with large floral decoration, heading, and map button. Typically placed at bottom of pages.

editable_as_blocks.description: CTA headline — white text on dark background

patterns.title: Menyliste – Kategori med priser
patterns.description: One menu category with a styled title and a list of items showing name, description, and price.

html_only.description: Title (H2), all items with names, descriptions, prices — edit entirely via HTML view. Add/remove <li> elements to change items.

patterns.usage_note: Insert this pattern multiple times for multiple categories (Konfekt, Kaker, Drikke). Edit the H2 title and each list item in HTML view.

patterns.title: Tidslinje – Historisk oversikt
patterns.description: Vertical timeline with year, step title, and description. Shows milestones from 1998 to present.

html_only.description: All timeline steps (<li> elements) — edit years, titles, and descriptions via HTML view. Add/remove <li> elements for new milestones.

patterns.title: Verdier – Fire-kolonne kortgrid
patterns.description: 4-column responsive grid of cards with FlowerMark icon, title, and description. For core values or features.

html_only.description: Decorative flower icon on each card

patterns.title: Sitat – Stort sentrert
patterns.description: Large centered quote with FlowerMark and attribution. Good as a closing section on any page.

editable_as_blocks.description: The quote text and citation (<cite>) are editable inside the quote block
